html:
A South American trade bloc founded by Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay and Uruguay with the Treaty of Asunción in 1991. Its name means "Southern Common Market".

It grew out of a new friendship between Argentina and Brazil, long rivals, after both returned to democracy in the 1980s. Members cut tariffs on trade among themselves and in 1995 set a common external tariff on goods from outside, making it a customs union, though with many exceptions. It also built ties of politics and travel: citizens of member countries can live and work in the others.

Venezuela joined but was suspended in 2016, and Bolivia became a full member in 2024. Other South American states are associates. Mercosur's progress has often stalled in crises, such as Argentina's collapse in 2001. It spent over twenty years negotiating a trade deal with the European Union. With NAFTA to the north, it was part of a wave of regional trade blocs in the 1990s.
sum: A South American trade bloc founded by Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay and Uruguay with the Treaty of Asunción in 1991. Its name means "Southern Common Market".
